ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure is the power supply V∠0°, followed by the stator resistance R1 and the stator leakage reactance jXl1 connected in series. On the right side there are upper and lower two equivalent branch blocks; on the left side of each branch block there is the magnetizing reactance jXM/2, and on the right side each respectively contains the rotor equivalent impedance. The rotor resistance of the upper branch is labeled R2'/(2s), and is connected in series with jXi2'/2; the rotor resistance of the lower branch is labeled R2'/(2(2-s)), and is connected in series with jXi2'/2. The upper and lower two branch blocks are then connected in series with the preceding R1 and jXl1 to form the input equivalent impedance. Reasoning: According to the problem statement, at no-load the speed is approximately synchronous, therefore slip s = 0. According to the specified method, R2'/(2s) in the upper branch tends to infinity when s=0, so the upper branch only leaves Zupper = jXM/2 = j120 Ω. The lower branch is Zlower = (jXM/2) || (R2'/(2(2-s)) + jXi2'/2). Substituting R2'=12 Ω, Xi2'=12 Ω, XM=240 Ω, s=0, obtain Zlower = j120 || (3 + j6). Calculate the parallel connection: Zlower = (j120(3+j6))/(j120+3+j6) = (j120(3+j6))/(3+j126) ≈ 2.7195 + j5.7790 Ω. Input impedance Zinput = (R1 + jXi1) + Zupper + Zlower = (12+j12) + j120 + (2.7195+j5.7790) = 14.7195 + j137.7790 Ω. Power factor pf = Re(Zinput)/|Zinput| = 14.7195/sqrt(14.7195^2 + 137.7790^2) ≈ 0.106. Since the imaginary part of the input impedance is positive, the current lags the voltage, so it is a lagging power factor.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中的单相感应电动机等效电路左侧为电源 V∠0°，上方串联有定子电阻 R1 和漏抗 jXi1。之后电路分成沿竖直方向串接的两个场分量部分：上半部分含励磁支路 jXM/2，并与转子支路 R2'/(2s) + jXi2'/2 并联；下半部分含励磁支路 jXM/2，并与转子支路 R2'/{2(2-s)} + jXi2'/2 并联。
推理：按指定方法，在空载时转速近似同步速，所以 s = 0。给定 R1 = R2' = Xi1 = Xi2' = 12 ohm，XM = 240 ohm，因此 jXM/2 = j120，jXi2'/2 = j6。上半部分因 R2'/(2s) 在 s=0 时趋于无穷大，转子支路开路，所以上半部分等效为 Zupper = j120。下半部分中 R2'/{2(2-s)} = 12/[2(2-0)] = 3 ohm，转子支路为 3 + j6，与 j120 并联。其导纳为 Ylower = 1/(j120) + 1/(3+j6) = -j0.008333 + (0.066667 - j0.133333) = 0.066667 - j0.141667。反演得 Zlower = 1/Ylower = 2.7195 + j5.7790 ohm。归一化输入电流为 1 A 后，总等效串联电阻 Rtot = R1 + Rlower = 12 + 2.7195 = 14.7195 ohm；总等效串联电抗 Xtot = Xi1 + 120 + Xlower = 12 + 120 + 5.7790 = 137.7790 ohm。功率因数 pf = Rtot / sqrt(Rtot^2 + Xtot^2) = 14.7195 / sqrt(14.7195^2 + 137.7790^2) = 0.10623。因此空载功率因数为滞后 0.106。
